name: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) IS 10500:2012 Drinking Water Specification

ph.description: Acceptable limit is 6.5 to 8.5. No relaxation.

tds.description: Acceptable limit is 500 mg/L. Permissible limit in the absence of an alternate source is 2000 mg/L.

turbidity.description: Acceptable limit is 1 NTU. Permissible limit in the absence of an alternate source is 5 NTU.

hardness.description: Acceptable limit is 200 mg/L. Permissible limit in the absence of an alternate source is 600 mg/L.

chlorine.description: Minimum residual chlorine should be 0.2 mg/L in distribution system for disinfection.

fluoride.description: Acceptable limit is 1.0 mg/L. Permissible limit in the absence of an alternate source is 1.5 mg/L.
